```html
<div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-screen bg-gray-50">
    <div class="p-8 max-w-md">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Edit Tag</h1>
        <form wire:submit.prevent="updateTag" class="mt-8 space-y-4">
            <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">Tag Name</label>
            <input type="text" id="name" class="w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 p-2 shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500" wire:model="tagName">

            <button type="submit" class="w-full rounded-md bg-indigo-500 py-2 text-center text-white font-medium hover:bg-indigo-600">Update Tag</button>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
import Alpine from 'alpinejs';

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    Alpine.start();
});
</script>
```

This Livewire blade view creates a form to edit the tag name. It uses Tailwind CSS for styling and Alpine.js for event handling. The form includes a text input field for the tag name with wire:model to bind the input value to the `tagName` property in the component's data. When the user submits the form, it calls the `updateTag` method using wire:submit.prevent, which you would need to define in your Livewire component to save the updated tag name to your database or other storage mechanism.
